title: sos_rate_limiting.json cooldown_resets_on_accept disagrees with last-alert cooldown
description: Vector cooldown_resets_on_accept accepts a third SOS at 600000 ms after burst sends at 0 and 1000 ms. SosRateLimitState (and spec 18.4.3 10-minute cooldown) measures from the most recent accepted alert, so 599 s after t=1 s is still cooling down. Because that third send is not recorded, t=601000 ms then opens in Rust (600 s elapsed) while the vector still rejects. hourly_window_slides has a related unit issue: current_uptime_ms=3600001 with history 0/1000/2000 ms expects sos_in_window=2; integer-second conversion maps now to 3600 s and keeps all three samples. Independent oracle: spec table cooldown 10 minutes. Do not change the limiter to match the JSON without a spec change.
